signals.text: Following the injury to Nick Bosa this week, the #49ers worked out edge Matt Judon, LB Jamin Davis, DE Julian Okwara and DE Dawuane Smoot.
Having lost six defensive lineman in the past two weeks, the 49ers worked out LB Matt Judon, LB Jamin Davis, DE Julian Okwara and DE Dawuane Smoot.
More about Bears QB Caleb Williams being ruled out for Monday night vs. the Eagles and backup QB Tyson Bagent returning to practice today, via @CourtneyRCronin: https://t.co/8nmcEmZeKV

Bengals have placed WR Andrei Iosivas on injured reserve, signed LB Joe Giles-Harris off their practice squad to their active roster, and elevated TE Tanner Hudson from their practice squad to their active roster. https://t.co/E4YzIQN3Jy
Chargers placed guard/tackle Trey Pipkins III on injured reserve, signed quarterback DJ Uiagalelei to their active roster and elevated tight end Patrick Herbert to their active roster.
Eagles RB Saquon Barkley and WR DeVonta Smith officially are off the injury report and good to go Monday night vs. the Bears. WR Hollywood Brown is out. https://t.co/XccGocju2s

Bears are listing QB Tyson Bagent as questionable for Monday night’s game vs. the Eagles.
#Bears QB Tyson Bagent has advanced enough in the concussion protocol to practice today. He has not yet been ruled out for MNF, but a few steps to go.

Colts officially placed wide receiver Alec Pierce on injured reserve and elevated wide receiver Nick Westbrook-Ikhine to their active roster from their practice squad for Sunday’s game against the Texans.

With wide receiver AD Mitchell listed as questionable for Sunday’s game vs. the Lions, the Jets signed WR Jamaal Pritchett to their active roster and elevated WR Sterling Shepard from their practice squad.

Five-time Pro-Bowl DE Nick Bosa pulled his calf during Thursday’s practice and now is expected to miss “a few weeks”, including Sunday’s game vs. the Cardinals, sources tell me and @RapSheet. The team is figuring out whether or not Bosa needs to be placed on injured reserve. https://t.co/eQIb7JBKut
